Key holding

In a labour hire arrangement, the true employer for insurance purposes may be the labour hire company where the commercial and contractual framework provides that workers placed with the host become its employees, notwithstanding the host’s recruitment and setting of work conditions.

In conclusion, I am satisfied that the commercial scenario in which BTR and JPBC operated meant that upon the plaintiff being accepted as suitable for the position at BTR, that the plaintiff then became an employee of JPBC.

19 Feb 2026Supreme Court of Queensland[2026] QSC 16
Key holding

In assessing general damages for mesothelioma, the Queensland Supreme Court may accord weight to jury verdicts and interstate decisions as comparators.

Weight should be accorded to jury decisions on the quantum of general damages. Weight should be accorded to the interstate cases.
